sentences.en: The company was accused of allowing managers to bully their staff.
sentences.zh: 该公司被指控纵容经理欺凌员工。

meaning.en: Repeated behaviour intended to hurt, frighten, or control someone

sentences.en: She reported the bullying to her teacher after lunch.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，她向老师报告了遭受欺凌的事。

sentences.en: Schools should address bullying through clear reporting procedures and consistent support for affected students.
sentences.zh: 学校应通过明确的举报程序和持续的受害学生支持措施来应对霸凌。

meaning.zh: 笨拙行事；跌跌撞撞地行动
meaning.en: to act or move in a clumsy, confused way

sentences.en: He will bumble through the speech.
sentences.zh: 他会笨拙地讲完那篇演讲。

sentences.en: She bumbled around the kitchen, knocking over pots and pans.
sentences.zh: 她在厨房里笨手笨脚地转来转去，碰倒了锅碗瓢盆。

meaning.en: to hit something lightly or accidentally

sentences.en: Do not bump the glass table.
sentences.zh: 不要撞到玻璃桌。

sentences.en: She bumped her head on the low door frame as she hurried out.
sentences.zh: 她匆忙出去时，头撞到了低矮的门框上。

meaning.en: a small, round bread roll

sentences.en: I bought a bun for breakfast.
sentences.zh: 我买了一个小圆面包当早餐。

sentences.en: She spread butter on a warm bun.
sentences.zh: 她在热乎乎的小圆面包上涂了黄油。

meaning.zh: 一束；一串；一群（同类事物聚在一起）
meaning.en: a group of things of the same type that are growing or fastened together

sentences.en: He gave her a bunch of flowers.
sentences.zh: 他送给她一束花。

sentences.en: She bought a bunch of bananas and a bunch of grapes at the market.
sentences.zh: 她在市场上买了一串香蕉和一串葡萄。

meaning.en: a collection of things tied or wrapped together

sentences.en: He carried a bundle of blankets into the room.
sentences.zh: 他抱着一捆毯子走进了屋里。

sentences.en: The charity received a bundle of letters from grateful families.
sentences.zh: 该慈善机构收到了受助家庭寄来的一捆感谢信。

meaning.zh: 捆扎；把…捆在一起（常指搭配销售）
meaning.en: to tie or wrap things together, often for sale as a set

sentences.en: Shops bundle the pens and sell them cheaply.
sentences.zh: 商店把这些笔捆在一起便宜出售。

sentences.en: Offering internet and telephone services as a bundle may reduce costs, but consumers should compare contracts carefully.
sentences.zh: 将网络和电话服务捆绑提供可能降低费用，但消费者应仔细比较合同。

meaning.en: A house with all rooms on one floor.

sentences.en: They bought a bungalow with a small sunny garden.
sentences.zh: 他们买了一栋带有阳光充足的小花园的平房。

sentences.en: Bungalows can suit older residents because their single-storey design removes the need to climb stairs.
sentences.zh: 平房适合老年居民居住，因为单层设计让他们无需爬楼梯。

meaning.en: A strong stretchy cord used for securing objects or bungee jumping.

sentences.en: We secured the sleeping bags with a strong bungee.
sentences.zh: 我们用一根结实的弹力绳固定住了睡袋。

sentences.en: Adventure tourism operators must inspect every bungee cord regularly to ensure that essential safety standards are maintained.
sentences.zh: 探险旅游经营者必须定期检查每根蹦极绳，以确保符合基本安全标准。

meaning.en: a narrow bed, especially one of two beds fixed one above the other

sentences.en: He slept in the top bunk.
sentences.zh: 他睡在上铺。

sentences.en: Providing each passenger with a comfortable bunk could make overnight trains more attractive than short flights.
sentences.zh: 为每位乘客提供舒适的铺位，能让夜间列车比短途航班更有吸引力。

meaning.en: a strongly built shelter, often underground, used for protection against bombs or attack

sentences.en: Soldiers hid in a concrete bunker.
sentences.zh: 士兵们躲在一个混凝土掩体里。

sentences.en: The family converted an old wartime bunker into a wine cellar.
sentences.zh: 这家人把一座战时的旧地堡改造成了酒窖。

meaning.zh: 小兔子（尤指宠物兔或儿童用语）
meaning.en: a rabbit, especially a small or pet one, used especially by or to children

sentences.en: A white bunny sat in the green grass.
sentences.zh: 一只白色的小兔子坐在绿草地上。

sentences.en: The little girl hugged her stuffed bunny before going to sleep.
sentences.zh: 小女孩睡觉前抱着她的兔子玩偶。

meaning.en: a floating object used to mark a place or warn of danger in water

sentences.en: A red buoy marks the safe channel.
sentences.zh: 一个红色浮标标示着安全航道。

sentences.en: The fishing boat drifted past the buoy before the storm arrived.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨来临前，渔船漂过了那个浮标。

meaning.en: a problem or responsibility that causes a lot of work or worry

sentences.en: The extra work became a heavy burden.
sentences.zh: 额外的工作成了沉重的负担。

sentences.en: Affordable childcare can reduce the financial burden on families and help parents return to work.
sentences.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务可以减轻家庭的经济负担，帮助父母重返职场。

meaning.en: causing difficulty through excessive work, worry, or expense

sentences.en: The extra paperwork became burdensome during our busiest week.
sentences.zh: 在我们最忙的那一周，额外的文书工作成了沉重负担。

sentences.en: Overly burdensome regulations may discourage small businesses from expanding, even when demand for their products is strong.
sentences.zh: 过于繁重的监管规定可能阻碍小企业扩张，即使其产品需求旺盛也是如此。

meaning.en: an office or organization that does official work

sentences.en: He works at the tourist bureau.
sentences.zh: 他在旅游局工作。

sentences.en: A national statistics bureau collects reliable data that governments use to plan public services.
sentences.zh: 国家统计局收集可靠数据，供政府规划公共服务之用。

meaning.zh: 官僚体制；行政体系；（常含贬义）官僚作风，繁文缛节
meaning.en: a system of government or administration run by officials; (often disapproving) complicated official rules and procedures

sentences.en: My aunt works within the city's large bureaucracy.
sentences.zh: 我姑姑在这个城市庞大的行政体系内工作。

sentences.en: Reducing unnecessary bureaucracy could help small businesses obtain permits more quickly without weakening essential safety standards.
sentences.zh: 减少不必要的繁文缛节，能帮助小企业更快取得许可证，同时不削弱必要的安全标准。

meaning.zh: 官僚主义的；官僚体制的
meaning.en: relating to a bureaucracy, often with complicated rules and slow processes

sentences.en: The company has a bureaucratic system for approving new projects.
sentences.zh: 这家公司审批新项目的制度很官僚。

sentences.en: Many citizens complain that bureaucratic procedures make it difficult to get public services.
sentences.zh: 许多市民抱怨官僚程序使获得公共服务变得困难。

meaning.en: to grow or develop quickly

sentences.en: New shops burgeon in the town.
sentences.zh: 新的商店在镇上迅速发展起来。

sentences.en: Demand for online courses has burgeoned as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop professional skills.
sentences.zh: 随着越来越多成年人寻求灵活提升职业技能的机会，在线课程的需求迅速增长。

meaning.zh: 汉堡包（常指夹肉饼或素饼的圆面包）
meaning.en: A round bread roll filled with a meat or vegetarian patty and often other ingredients

sentences.en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我午餐点了一个豆类汉堡配沙拉。

sentences.en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
sentences.zh: 餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。

meaning.en: a person who illegally enters a building, especially a house, to steal things

sentences.en: A burglar broke into our house while we were away.
sentences.zh: 我们不在家时，一名窃贼闯入了我们的房子。

sentences.en: Improved street lighting and secure doors may discourage burglars from targeting homes in residential areas.
sentences.zh: 改善街道照明并安装牢固的门，可能使窃贼不敢对住宅区的房屋下手。

meaning.en: the crime of entering a building illegally and stealing things from it

sentences.en: The burglary happened during the night.
sentences.zh: 这起入室盗窃发生在夜间。

sentences.en: Police are investigating a series of burglaries in the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 警方正在调查该社区发生的一系列入室盗窃案。

meaning.en: to enter a building illegally and steal things from it

sentences.en: Thieves tried to burgle the empty house.
sentences.zh: 窃贼试图入室盗窃那栋空房子。

sentences.en: The family was away when someone burgled their apartment.
sentences.zh: 有人入室盗窃他们家公寓时，这家人正外出不在。

meaning.en: the act or ceremony of placing a dead body underground

sentences.en: The family gathered for the burial of their grandfather.
sentences.zh: 一家人聚在一起参加祖父的葬礼。

sentences.en: Ancient burial sites provide valuable evidence about the beliefs and social structures of past communities.
sentences.zh: 古代墓葬遗址为了解过去社会的信仰和社会结构提供了宝贵证据。

meaning.en: to be on fire or to damage something with fire

sentences.en: Do not burn the toast, please.
sentences.zh: 壁炉里，一小团火静静地燃烧着。

sentences.en: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.
sentences.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放温室气体，因此清洁能源对环境保护至关重要。

meaning.en: The part of a cooker or heater that produces heat

sentences.en: She turned off the burner after the soup boiled.
sentences.zh: 汤煮开后，她关掉了炉头。

sentences.en: Replacing inefficient gas burners with cleaner cooking technology can reduce indoor air pollution and improve health.
sentences.zh: 用更清洁的烹饪技术替代低效燃气炉头，可以减少室内空气污染并改善健康。

meaning.en: on fire; very hot; intense

sentences.en: The burning fire kept us warm.
sentences.zh: 燃烧的火让我们保持温暖。

sentences.en: She felt a burning desire to succeed.
sentences.zh: 她感到一种强烈的成功欲望。

meaning.en: to let air out of the stomach through the mouth, often noisily

sentences.en: The baby gave a loud burp.
sentences.zh: 婴儿打了一个响嗝。

sentences.en: He tried to burp quietly so no one would notice.
sentences.zh: 他尽量小声打嗝，以免被人注意到。

meaning.en: to dig a hole or tunnel into the ground, or to move into such a hole

sentences.en: Rabbits burrow under the ground to hide.
sentences.zh: 兔子在地下挖洞藏身。

sentences.en: Animals that burrow underground can improve soil quality by allowing air and water to penetrate deeper layers.
sentences.zh: 在地下挖洞的动物能让空气和水进入更深的土层，从而改善土壤质量。

meaning.en: to break open or apart suddenly, especially from internal pressure

sentences.en: The balloon will burst if you sit on it.
sentences.zh: 如果你坐在气球上，它会爆裂。

sentences.en: The water pipe burst during the cold winter night, flooding the basement.
sentences.zh: 寒冷的冬夜水管爆裂了，淹了地下室。

meaning.en: to put something in the ground and cover it, especially a dead body

sentences.en: Dogs bury bones in the garden.
sentences.zh: 狗把骨头埋在花园里。

sentences.en: Instead of burying household waste, local authorities should invest in recycling facilities and public education.
sentences.zh: 地方政府不应只是填埋生活垃圾，而应投资建设回收设施并开展公众教育。

meaning.en: a large road vehicle that carries many passengers, usually along a fixed route

sentences.en: I take the bus to school every morning.
sentences.zh: 我每天早上坐公交车去学校。

sentences.en: More frequent bus services could reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment in outer suburbs.
sentences.zh: 增加公交班次可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善远郊居民的就业出行条件。

meaning.en: a place where buses stop for passengers to get on or off

sentences.en: I'll meet you at the bus station.
sentences.zh: 我在公交车站见你。

sentences.en: The bus station was crowded with travelers during the holiday.
sentences.zh: 假期期间，汽车站挤满了旅客。

meaning.en: a place where a bus regularly stops for passengers to get on or off

sentences.en: I'll wait for you at the bus stop.
sentences.zh: 我会在公共汽车站等你。

sentences.en: The bus stop is just a five-minute walk from my apartment.
sentences.zh: 公共汽车站离我的公寓只有五分钟的步行路程。

meaning.en: a plant with many branches, smaller than a tree

sentences.en: A bird hides in the green bush.
sentences.zh: 一只小鸟躲在绿色的灌木丛里。

sentences.en: Planting native bushes in urban gardens can provide shelter and food for local wildlife.
sentences.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地灌木，可以为当地野生动物提供庇护和食物。

meaning.en: A unit of dry volume used especially for grain.

sentences.en: The farmer measured out a bushel of wheat.
sentences.zh: 农民量出了一蒲式耳小麦。

sentences.en: Reporting grain prices per bushel allows farmers to compare market conditions before deciding when to sell their crops.
sentences.zh: 按每蒲式耳报告谷物价格，便于农民比较市场行情，再决定何时出售作物。

meaning.en: the activity of buying and selling goods or services, or a company that does this

sentences.en: Dad has a small business.
sentences.zh: 这家咖啡馆周一的生意通常比较清淡。

sentences.en: Small businesses often create local employment, but they may struggle to compete with larger companies.
sentences.zh: 小企业通常能为当地创造就业机会，但可能难以与大公司竞争。

meaning.en: a person who works in business, especially at a senior level

sentences.en: She is a successful business person who runs her own company.
sentences.zh: 她是一位成功的商务人士，经营着自己的公司。

sentences.en: As a business person, he has to travel frequently and attend many meetings.
sentences.zh: 作为一名商务人士，他不得不经常出差并参加许多会议。

meaning.en: A man who works in business, especially as an owner or manager.

sentences.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
sentences.zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。

sentences.en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。

meaning.en: A woman who works in business, especially one who runs a company or is in a senior position.

sentences.en: She is a successful businesswoman who runs her own company.
sentences.zh: 她是一位成功的女商人，经营着自己的公司。

sentences.en: The conference brought together businesswomen from across Asia to discuss investment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 这次会议汇聚了来自亚洲各地的女企业家，共同讨论投资机会。

meaning.en: a statue of a person's head and shoulders

sentences.en: A marble bust stood in the hall.
sentences.zh: 大厅里立着一尊大理石半身像。

sentences.en: Displaying a bust of a local artist can help museums connect visitors with their community's cultural history.
sentences.zh: 展出当地艺术家的半身像，有助于博物馆让参观者了解所在社区的文化历史。

meaning.en: busy, noisy activity or movement

sentences.en: I like the bustle of the market.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢市场里熙熙攘攘的气氛。

sentences.en: She enjoys the bustle of city life, even though it can be exhausting.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢城市生活的忙碌喧闹，尽管那可能让人疲惫。

meaning.en: having a lot of things to do or being fully occupied with something

sentences.en: Mum is busy in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 妈妈在厨房里忙着。

sentences.en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
sentences.zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能让人不愿骑车，除非地方政府提供与机动车流隔离的安全路线。

meaning.en: used to introduce a contrasting idea or statement

sentences.en: The bag looks small, but it can hold everything I need.
sentences.zh: 这个包看起来小，却能装下我需要的所有东西。

sentences.en: Public transport can reduce traffic congestion, but services must be reliable enough to attract regular users.
sentences.zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，但服务必须足够可靠，才能吸引经常乘坐的乘客。

meaning.en: only; just

sentences.en: She is but a child and needs help.
sentences.zh: 她只是个孩子，需要帮助。

meaning.en: a person who cuts up meat for sale

sentences.en: The butcher cut the meat for us.
sentences.zh: 肉贩为我们切了肉。

sentences.en: A local butcher can help customers reduce food waste by recommending suitable cuts and portion sizes.
sentences.zh: 当地肉贩可以推荐合适的肉块和分量，帮助顾客减少食物浪费。

meaning.en: the head male servant in a house

sentences.en: The butler opened the door for the guests.
sentences.zh: 男管家为客人们开了门。

sentences.en: In the old mansion, the butler managed the household staff and greeted visitors.
sentences.zh: 在那座老宅里，男管家管理家仆并接待访客。

meaning.en: the short part left after a cigarette has been smoked

sentences.en: He swept a cigarette butt off the front step.
sentences.zh: 他把门前台阶上的一个烟蒂扫掉了。

sentences.en: Discarded cigarette butts contribute to urban litter and can release harmful substances into rivers and coastal waters.
sentences.zh: 随意丢弃的烟蒂增加了城市垃圾，还可能向河流和近岸水域释放有害物质。

meaning.en: a yellow spread made from milk

sentences.en: Spread butter on the warm bread.
sentences.zh: 在温热的面包上抹些黄油。

sentences.en: Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.
sentences.zh: 用不饱和油脂替代部分黄油，有助于减少饱和脂肪的总体摄入量。

meaning.en: an insect with large colorful wings

sentences.en: A butterfly lands on the flower.
sentences.zh: 一只蝴蝶落在花上。

sentences.en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
sentences.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。

meaning.en: a small round object used for fastening clothes

sentences.en: A button fell off my coat.
sentences.zh: 我外套上掉了一颗纽扣。

sentences.en: She sewed a new button onto her shirt.
sentences.zh: 她在衬衫上缝了一颗新纽扣。

meaning.en: a small part on a machine that you press to make it work

sentences.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
sentences.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

sentences.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
sentences.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

meaning.en: to get something by paying money for it

sentences.en: We buy fruit at the market.
sentences.zh: 我们在市场上买水果。

sentences.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
sentences.zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。

meaning.en: a person or organization that buys something

sentences.en: The buyer checked the bike carefully before paying cash.
sentences.zh: 买家在付现金前仔细检查了那辆自行车。

sentences.en: First-time buyers often struggle to enter the housing market because property prices rise faster than wages.
sentences.zh: 由于房价上涨速度超过工资，首次购房者往往难以进入住房市场。

meaning.en: a continuous low humming or murmuring sound

sentences.en: A low buzz came from the busy bees.
sentences.zh: 忙碌的蜜蜂发出低沉的嗡嗡声。

sentences.en: The buzz of conversation filled the café.
sentences.zh: 咖啡馆里充满了嘈杂的谈话声。

meaning.en: at the side of or near something

sentences.en: She sits by the window.
sentences.zh: 她坐在窗边。

sentences.en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
sentences.zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。

meaning.en: in a way that is not planned or intended; by chance

sentences.en: I found the old photo by accident while cleaning the room.
sentences.zh: 我在打扫房间时偶然发现了那张旧照片。

sentences.en: She discovered the secret by accident, not by design.
sentences.zh: 她意外地发现了这个秘密，并非有意为之。

meaning.en: traveling or being sent by plane

sentences.en: We talked about by air at school.

meaning.en: by mail; using the postal system

sentences.en: Please send the form by post.
sentences.zh: 请通过邮寄方式寄送表格。

sentences.en: The documents were delivered by post rather than email.
sentences.zh: 这些文件是通过邮寄而不是电子邮件送达的。

meaning.zh: 顺便说一下；顺便问一句（用于引出题外话或补充说明）
meaning.en: used to introduce a remark that is not directly connected with the main topic

sentences.en: We talked about by the way at school.

meaning.en: used as an informal way of saying goodbye

sentences.en: Bye! See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 再见！明天见。

sentences.en: She waved and said bye to everyone at the party.
sentences.zh: 她挥了挥手，向聚会上的每个人道别。

meaning.zh: 轮空（体育比赛中无需比赛直接晋级）
meaning.en: a situation in a sports competition in which a player or team advances to the next round without playing

sentences.en: Our team got a bye in the first round.
sentences.zh: 我们队在第一轮轮空。

sentences.en: Because of the bye, the player had extra time to rest before the next match.
sentences.zh: 由于轮空，这名选手在下一场比赛前有额外的时间休息。

meaning.en: to go around something instead of through it

sentences.en: Doctors may bypass the blocked artery.
sentences.zh: 医生可能会绕过阻塞的动脉。

sentences.en: A new bypass could reduce congestion in the town centre but might damage nearby wildlife habitats.
sentences.zh: 新建绕城公路可以缓解镇中心的拥堵，但也可能破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。
